title: Docs, model edges, and the CLI's exit codes
summary: Every thing and operation now has a generated docs page. Spend's page lists who may call it, what goes in and comes out, its move, its two steps, and each refusal with its exit code: AllowanceExceeded 41, AllowanceNotActive 40, NotAllowed 3. The model also lists what depends on what. On a real local world, the generated acme command line spends, prints the answer as JSON when asked, exits 41 past the limit, 3 for an outsider, and 40 once the allowance is revoked.
proves: acme allowance spend past the limit exits 41; generated/docs/allowance/spend.md lists AllowanceExceeded and AllowanceNotActive.

captions.01-cli-exit-codes-on-a-real-world: On workerd: the generated CLI spends 200 with --json, then 301 past what's left exits 41, bob revoking exits 3, and spending a revoked allowance exits 40.
captions.02-render-docs-and-edges: The renderer's tests, including the docs pages and the model's edges.
captions.04-sync-check: generated/ matches the blueprint, docs included.
